name: ASCII / Bayer dither
doc: Renders its input as procedural ASCII glyph cells mapped by luma or as an ordered 8x8 Bayer dither, with cell size breathing with bass and phosphor accents pulsing on onsets.

palette.doc: optional palette for palette-colorized ASCII or Bayer dither

mode.doc: pure ASCII ramp, ordered 8x8 Bayer dither, or Bayer-dithered ASCII glyphs

cell.doc: glyph cell height in pixels at 1080p

bass.doc: how much bass breathes the cell size

color.doc: glyph tinting: original source color, monochrome phosphor ink, or palette

levels.doc: quantization levels in Bayer dither mode

contrast.doc: luma contrast into glyph density or dither

ink.doc: foreground phosphor color in phosphor mode
